Main function.description: Noma entry point returning an exit code

Function.description: Function with explicit parameter and return types

Async main function.description: Async entry point driven by the Noma executor

Async function.description: Lazy async function; a call returns Future of the declared result type

Read argument.description: Temporary readonly borrow; insert directly into a synchronous call argument

Array binding.description: Array literal with its required explicit expected type

Array length.description: Read an array length without copying; requires std/arr imported as arr

Future binding.description: Store a lazy Future in a readonly binding

Await result.description: Consume a Future once inside an async function

Immutable binding.description: Readonly binding with an explicit type

Mutable binding.description: Mutable binding with an explicit type

Snapshot binding.description: Keep an independent readonly snapshot of a value

Module import.description: Import a module with the mandatory alias

Match expression.description: Typed cases; adjust them to exhaust the input union

Catch handler.description: Postfix error handler; the error path must exit (never)

Raise error result.description: Exit a function whose result includes throwable

Otherwise handler.description: Postfix error handler producing a compatible fallback value
